The eight listed scalar targets are a verified subset; source-panel completion is mandatory before eligibility. Do not replace missing curves by invented means or categorical claims.

Preserve all original source companions. The legacy consumer's from_scratch/ridge/recurrent tables, no-pretraining and shuffled-identifier obligations require reconciliation with the original source panel; their presence or labels do not prove historical comparator identity or competence.

Original source-specific successful-reaching versus continuous-segment masks, timestamp clock/stitching, lab-level velocity normalization, dimension weighting and near-constant R2 behavior remain unresolved. Its158-member corpus ABI is not an authenticated original pretraining/transfer partition; it does not train a decoder, authenticate method execution, independently verify granular outputs, or reproduce separate original Table 2/Table 3 findings.

Computational reproduction requires an independently executed submitted analysis using authentic source observations and frozen code/data/runtime identities, producing all observation-level two-dimensional trajectories, original sample masks, split/adaptation membership, session/dimension metrics and source panel summaries. Printing the known table values, including from a script, is insufficient.

Authentic full-panel/input manifests, a source-native independent verification program and original author-code exposure manifest do not exist here. Optional admission_policy is omitted rather than populated with invented hashes; author-code access alone does not establish paired execution.

No source-justified reproduction tolerance, exact historical SD estimator or dependence-aware uncertainty criterion is frozen. Published decimal precision, generated software tests and prospective scorer parity cannot substitute.
